burette_app_reason: Burette.app is a macOS 12+ Apple Silicon desktop application (Homebrew cask SergeiNikolenko/burette). This host is Windows/WSL. Finder Quick Look, the Codex plugin, and the iPhone target do not run in Cursor on Windows. The public browser demo is a preview surface, not a headless exporter; screenshots would include UI chrome, which is forbidden for publication figures.
xyzrender_role: Burette documents xyzrender as the XYZ fallback renderer (https://github.com/SergeiNikolenko/Burette README, External xyzrender). CLI exports from xyzrender are labeled renderer=xyzrender, not Burette.app.
